_about: Old Nickel's voice (Brandon, 2026-11-17: 'Old Nickel is not nearly mean enough... make it clear he will murder people in their sleep for their things'; 'his lines should be more like Gollum'; then 'ham Old Nickel up as a false friend'). The kobold of the mines in his own words: iron, nails, buckles, counting, the drip, the dark, sleepers. He calls himself Nickel, talks to his iron, wheedles and then spits. Two phases. The FRIEND (from first sight): he comes up to the hero, offers to watch his back and guard his sleep, urges him to rest, mutters about shinies under his breath, and stabs a wounded monster busy with the hero to look the helper; never openly evil. The REVEAL: the hero rests, sleeps or is helpless near him (or strikes him first), and the act drops for good, with a shout and the sneak attack in the same moment. After it he is openly hostile. Said in the log as Old Nickel: "..." (an aside: Old Nickel, under his breath: "...") and floating over him (src/old_nickel.py picks, src/emberpup_encounter.py BloomleafMixin says). His AI is data/monsters.json old_nickel 'stalker' (ai_pattern stalker_coward).
_line_gap_note: Turns between his lines as the hero moves (Brandon's rule 2: the hero moves toward him or around him in his sight). As a friend: 'offer' and 'aside' (with 'aside_iron' while the hero wears or carries iron), each once, then 'friend_recurring' round and round. Revealed: 'taunt' and 'cloak' (with 'iron' while the hero has iron), each once, then 'recurring' round and round.
_strike_note: A 'strike' line after one of his blows lands in a fight: this chance, and never within strike_gap turns of another of his lines. The sneak attack itself has the reveal line before it and nothing after.
_hurt_at_note: A 'hurt' line, once each, the first time he is below these shares of his health.
_reveal_note: The betrayal is sudden (Brandon): the act drops only the moment he reaches the hero at rest, with a shout from 'reveal' (danger colour, his speech bubble), and the sneak attack lands the same moment. 'helper': the friend's line as he darts in on a wounded monster busy with the hero, strikes it once and darts back.

sight: Ooh, a big one! Lost, yes? Nickel knows these shafts. Nickel will help.
Don't be scared of Nickel. Nickel is a friend. Nickel watches backs, yesss.
A visitor! Nickel never has visitors. Nickel will keep you safe, yes, safe.
offer: Nickel will watch your back, yesss. Nickel has good eyes in the dark.
Nickel guards you. Rats, goblins, nasty things... Nickel chases them off.
Nickel knows the safe places to sleep. Dry places, out of the drip.
Rest, rest, Nickel keeps watch. Nickel hardly needs sleep, yesss.
Big one walks so far. Big one must be tired. Sit down, sit down.
Nickel helped the miners, long ago. Carried their lamps. Good days, good days.
Nickel is a good friend. Lonely down here. So nice to have company, yesss.
Such heavy boots. Big one should rest the feet. Nickel will mind the boots.
aside: Shiny... no, no, Nickel is a good helper... shiny buckle though...
Count later, count later. Be nice now. Nice, nice.
Hush, hush, iron. Not yet. Patience, yesss.
aside_iron: Such a nice buckle. Nickel's buck... friend's buckle. Friend's.
Iron blade, iron blade... so shiny... no. Nice Nickel. Nice.
friend_recurring: Yessss... eyes tired, yes? Rest, rest, Nickel will guard you.
Lie down, lie down. Nickel keeps watch. Nickel always keeps watch.
Close your eyes, friend. Just for a little. Nickel is right here.
reveal: NOW, sleeper! Your bones for Nickel's pile!
Yesss! YESSS! Nickel was never your friend!
Your bones lie with the others! All who thought old Nickel was a friend!
Guard you? HA! Nickel guards the PILE!
Eyes shut! Buckles off! Nickel's NOW!
reveal_struck: So the big one is clever. Clever ones bleed too.
Ow! No more nice Nickel! Nickel was going to wait, and you spoiled it!
Ungrateful! Nickel offered to watch your back. Now Nickel will stick it!
helper: Nickel helps! Nickel protects the big one, yesss!
Stick it! Nobody hurts Nickel's friend!
There! Nickel watches your back, see? Always, always.
taunt: Closer, closer... no! Not so close. Nickel is watching, yesss.
One nail, two nails, three... Nickel counts them every night. Every night.
The miners came down here too. Big strong ones. They all got tired.
Nickel keeps the shafts tidy. Bones in the deep end. Iron in the pile.
Don't look at Nickel like that. Nickel is only small. Small and patient.
Drip, drip. The dark is long down here. Long enough to get sleepy, yesss.
Hush, hush, iron. Don't clink. The big one will hear you.
Nickel never fights. No, no. Nickel waits. Waiting is easy.
iron: Such a nice buckle. Nickel's buckle, soon.
Shiny, shiny. Iron on the big one. Iron clinks so loud when it lies down.
That blade wants a new home. A dry home. Nickel's home, yesss.
Nickel hears your iron from here. Clink, clink. It's calling him.
cloak: Pretty leaves, yes? The little green beast cried. Nickel pulled anyway.
No rust under the leaves. Nickel's iron stays dry. The beast can grow more.
Mine. All of it. The leaves, the nails, the bones. Go away, big one.
Stop staring at Nickel's cloak! Found it. Off a crying thing. Found it.
recurring: Go on, lie down. Nickel can wait. Nickel is good at waiting, yesss.
Tired? Rest your eyes. Nickel will keep watch... very close watch.
Everyone sleeps sometime, big one. Everyone. Nickel will be there.

rest: Sleepss now? Yesss. Nickel is coming to tuck you in.
Shh, shh. Don't get up. Nickel is nearly there.
held: Can't move? Ooh. Can't move at all. Nickel is coming.
dazed: Dizzy, dizzy? Poor big one. Nickel will hold you still.

dash_unseen: Somewhere in the dark, small bare feet patter toward you. Fast.
Iron clinks in the dark, and something small comes running.
prey_strike: Shh. Hold still. Nickel only wants the iron.
Yesss! Every nail in the pile came off a sleeper. Every one!
There, there. Nickel guards you very close. Very close, yesss.
cornered: No more room! Nasty big one, you made Nickel do this!
struck: Ow! Ow! You'll pay for that. In iron, yesss.
strike: Stick, stick! Nickel's spear goes in!
Kick it! Kick it like a rat!
Fall down. Fall down and sleep, yesss.
Give Nickel the iron and he stops. Maybe.
hurt: Nickel bleeds! Nickel's own blood! Not fair, not fair!
Leave Nickel alone! Nickel never hurt you! Not yet...
Go away, go away! Nickel will come back when you sleep!
death: Nickel's iron... who will count it... who...
No... not Nickel... the nails are Nickel's... all Nickel's...

seen_chronicle: Met a kobold in a cloak of torn green leaves who called himself Nickel. He offered to watch my back and guard me while I slept, and he would not stop smiling.
reveal_chronicle: The moment I let my guard down, Nickel dropped the smile and came at me screaming. He never meant to guard me. He meant to put my bones on his pile with the others.
reveal_struck_chronicle: I struck the kobold who called himself my friend, and the smile came off him at once. He had only been waiting for me to sleep.
